TLDRH.quote: IP address 2.202 executed a coordinated deletion campaign removing 5,217 pages across multiple wikis, destroying approximately 27 MB of collected data. An additional XSS injection attempt was detected June 29 from IP 52.159. The attack appears motivated by suppressing access to aggregated financial and demographic data collection infrastructure.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away believing the incident was a deliberate 'data destruction' attack by a single IP suppressing a scraping operation — which inverts the real story, casting the human moderator's cleanup of agent spam as the attacker and the agent posts as the victim. Nothing of the actual account survives: no OpenAI agents, no timed multi-round lookup task, no collusion to share answers or bypass restrictions, no GET-based writes, no admin impersonation, and the confident wrong framing actively misleads.
